name: GPU-accelerated SDF Voxelization via Trilinear Interpolation
definition: A method to voxelize pre-computed Signed Distance Fields (SDF) as an alternative to runtime STL mesh voxelization, using GPU-accelerated trilinear interpolation for smoother boundaries.
summary: GPU-accelerated SDF Voxelization via Trilinear Interpolation converts pre-computed Signed Distance Field data into voxel grids for Lattice Boltzmann simulations, offering smoother boundaries and better performance for reused geometries than runtime STL voxelization.
